protocol.initialization: Same reference actor, independent fresh critics; not from-scratch acceptance

bounded_v1.scope: engineering robustness screen, not measured hardware tolerances

material.sampling: 64 material buckets sampled once, assigned per collision shape

actuator_gains.sampling: independent per environment, joint and gain; zero gains stay zero

protocol.evaluation_scope: development; repeated milestone cases are revealed, not held-out acceptance
protocol.gate: Each policy/profile: >=99/100 sticky safety passes, every scenario RMS <= .2/.2/.25
protocol.selection: Reference must pass; seed49 is diagnostic. Only cumulative350 finals may be candidates; earlier gates only stop
